mainEntity.name: What should I ask a contractor before starting a whole-house renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should ask for proof of licensing and insurance, recent project photos, references, a clear timeline, and a written estimate that spells out what is included. For whole-house interior renovation work in Denver and nearby suburbs, it is especially important to confirm who handles permits, how change orders are priced, and who manages day-to-day communication. Ask how they handle surprises behind the walls, because older homes often reveal issues once demolition starts. If a contractor cannot explain those basics clearly, keep looking.
acceptedAnswer.description: Ask about licensing, insurance, permits, timeline, communication, change orders, and past projects like yours. A clear written scope matters more than a low starting price.
